split_policy: last six kitchens and last six living rooms are whole-scene holdout; 12 of 60
gpu_assignment: fixed round robin within each declared ordered partition
notes: Legacy six scenes are reserved for the queued original job and explicitly identified retries; neither A nor B may run them.
Partition membership and order are fixed before results; no scene replacement on failure.
One Unity instance per GPU uses twelve disjoint affinity CPUs and avoids unmeasured multi-instance contention; every allocated GPU receives a nonempty scene shard.
Scientific displacement/evidence-pixel thresholds are pending. These runs only collect candidates and never count threshold-null rows as accepted.
